tasks.title: Fix Failing Tests
tasks.description: Fix the failing tests identified in AF-AUTO-000 baseline runs until the full test suite is stable enough for AF-AUTO-001 work.
success_criteria: Previously failing tests are categorized by root cause
At least one full pytest run completes with updated results documented
The number of failing tests is materially reduced or blockers are explicitly documented
A detailed fix report is created

tasks.title: Add Quick-Win Tests (Phase 1)
tasks.description: Add the quick-win tests identified in AF-AUTO-000-10 for critical but lightly tested services.
success_criteria: Tests added for signal_service
Tests added for failure_memory_service
Tests added for outcome_service
Tests added for search_service
Tests added for report_generator
A report summarizing quick-win test additions is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'signal_service or failure_memory_service or outcome_service or search_service or report_generator' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Complete Reasoning Layer TODOs
tasks.description: Implement the remaining TODO items in the reasoning layer that were identified during AF-AUTO-000.
success_criteria: LLM hypothesis generation is implemented or clearly stubbed behind a safe interface
Assertion query support is added in the evidence collector
Event query support is added in the evidence collector
Temporal correlation check is added in skeptic logic
A reasoning layer completion report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'reasoning or skeptic or evidence or scenarios' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Phase 2 - Critical Services Test Coverage
tasks.description: Add tests for high-risk core services and improve service-level coverage after quick-win tests are complete.
success_criteria: Tests added for paper_trading_service
Tests added for monitoring_service
Tests added for replay_service
Tests added for closed_loop_service
Tests added for governance_service
Coverage improves by approximately 10 percentage points or blockers are documented
A phase 2 coverage report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'paper_trading or monitoring or replay or closed_loop or governance' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Phase 3 - Knowledge Layer Test Coverage
tasks.description: Add tests for knowledge layer modules once critical service coverage work is complete.
success_criteria: Tests added for entity resolution
Tests added for assertion extraction or assertion workflows
Tests added for event extraction or event workflows
Tests added for graph projection
Tests added for retrieval including hybrid search and vector store logic where testable
A phase 3 coverage report is created
verification_commands: python -m pytest tests/ -k 'knowledge or entity_resolution or assertions or events or graph or retrieval' -v --tb=short

tasks.title: Phase 4 - Reach 75 Percent Coverage
tasks.description: Add remaining tests and close the most important coverage gaps until the repository reaches the AF-AUTO-001 target coverage level.
success_criteria: Overall test coverage reaches at least 75 percent or the exact blocker is documented
All critical modules have explicit test coverage status documented
A final AF-AUTO-001 coverage report is created
